title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: State Theater, Easton | 2026
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the State Theater in Easton, Pennsylvania, USA, on 24 September 2026.

It was the first show of the 16th All-Starr Band’s fall tour of the USA, which lasted for nine dates in September and October 2026.

The performance of The Beatles’ 1963 song ‘I Wanna Be Your Man’ was restarted during the first verse after Starr forgot the lyrics.

The All-Starr Band had been scheduled to perform at the State Theater on 11 June 2022, but it was one of 12 cancelled dates after Edgar Winter and Steve Lukather tested positive for Covid-19.

The 16th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar, bass guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar
  • Buck Johnson: vocals, keyboards
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, trumpet
